name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const ()) -> Thread
rule: If Thread::from_raw is called twice on the same raw pointer, the two resulting Thread instances must not both be dropped, as this can cause a double-free.
api: impl  std::thread::Thread { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const ()) -> std::thread::Thread }
expression: The requirement cannot be expressed in this DSL: it has no observations for repeated calls or future drops of the resulting Thread instances.
